chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from his father from Khalaf ibn Hammad al-Asadi from Abu al-Hasan al-Abdi from al-A'mash from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd. He said:

Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari was asked about Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), so he said: He is the best of Allah's creation from the first to the last, with the exception of the prophets and the messengers. Surely, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, did not create any creation after the prophets and the messengers more honored by Him than Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and the Imams from his descendants after him. I said: What do you say about those who hate him and diminish him? So, he said: None hate him except a disbeliever, and none diminish him except a hypocrite. I said: What do you say about those who take him as their master and take the Imams from his descendants after him as their masters? So, he said: Surely, the Shi'a of Ali and the Imams from his descendants are the triumphant and secure ones on the Day of Resurrection. Then he said: What do you think, if a man were to go out calling people to misguidance, who would be the closest people to him? They said: His followers and his supporters. He said: And if a man were to go out calling people to guidance, who would be the closest people to him? He said: His followers and his supporters. He said: Likewise Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) — in his hand will be the Banner of Praise on the Day of Resurrection. The closest people to him will be his followers and his supporters.

key_terms.الأئمة: The Imams; the divinely appointed leaders from the lineage of Ali
key_terms.خير خلق الله: The best of Allah's creation; a title indicating supreme rank after the prophets
key_terms.شيعة: Followers/partisans; those who support and align with Ali and the Imams
key_terms.كافر: Disbeliever; one who rejects the truth of Islam
key_terms.لواء الحمد: Banner of Praise; the standard carried on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.منافق: Hypocrite; one who conceals disbelief while outwardly professing Islam

ai.seo_question: What did Jabir ibn Abdullah say about the status of Ali ibn Abi Talib in Islam?
ai.summary: Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari is asked about Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) and declares him the best of creation after the prophets and messengers. He states that no one hates Ali except a disbeliever, and no one diminishes him except a hypocrite. He affirms that the Shi'a of Ali and the Imams from his lineage will be triumphant on the Day of Resurrection, using an analogy about followers of guidance and misguidance to illustrate that Ali's followers will be closest to him as he holds the Banner of Praise.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid al-Barqi from his father from Khalaf b. Hammad al-Asadi from Abi'l Hasan al-`Abdi from al-A`mash from Salim b. Abi'l Ju`d. He said:

Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari was asked about `Ali b. Abi Talib (as), so he said: He is the best creation of Allah from the beginning to the end, with exception to the prophets and messengers. Surely, Allah did not create a creation after the prophets and messengers that is more honoured by Him than `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) and the Imams from his descendants after him. I said: What do you say regarding those who hate him and detract from him? So, he said: None hate him except a disbeliever (kafir), and none detract from him except a hypocrite (munafiq). I said: What do you say regarding those who align with him and align with the Imams from his descendants after him? So, he said: Surely, the Shi`a of `Ali and the Imams after him from his descendants will be triumphant and safe on the Day of Resurrection. Then, he said: If a man were to come out and call the people to misguidance, who would be the closest people to him? They said: His party (shi`a) and his supporters. He said:  So, if a man were to come out and call the people to guidance, who would be the closest people be to him? They said: His party and his supporters. He said: It is the same with `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). In his hand will be the Banner of Praise on the Day of Resurrection. The closest people to him will be his Shi`a and his supporters.
